mapper.sql: v.id, v.vehicle_no, v.model_id, m.model_name, v.brand_id, b.brand_name, m.category_code, c.dict_label AS category_name, c.dict_value AS category_color, m.seats, m.gearbox, g.dict_label AS gearbox_name, m.fuel_type, f.dict_label AS fuel_type_name, m.displacement, v.daily_price, v.deposit, v.discount_rate, ROUND(v.daily_price * v.discount_rate, 2) AS final_price, COALESCE( (SELECT vi.image_url FROM vehicle_image vi WHERE vi.vehicle_id = v.id ORDER BY vi.sort_no, vi.id LIMIT 1), m.cover_image ) AS cover_image, v.store_id, s.store_name, v.status, st.dict_label AS status_name, st.dict_value AS status_color, v.rent_count, v.view_count, v.description

FROM vehicle v JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id AND m.deleted = 0 JOIN vehicle_brand b ON b.id = v.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN store s ON s.id = v.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data c ON c.dict_type = 'vehicle_category' AND c.dict_code = m.category_code AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data g ON g.dict_type = 'gearbox' AND g.dict_code = m.gearbox AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data f ON f.dict_type = 'fuel_type' AND f.dict_code = m.fuel_type AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data st ON st.dict_type = 'vehicle_status' AND st.dict_code = CAST(v.status AS CHAR) AND st.deleted = 0 AND st.status = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT , v.license_plate, v.vin, v.color, v.current_mileage, v.register_date, m.description AS model_description, s.address AS store_address, s.phone AS store_phone, s.business_hours
WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status != 0
SELECT id, image_url, image_type, sort_no FROM vehicle_image WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT dict_code AS code, dict_label AS label, dict_value AS color FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'vehicle_category' AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT id, brand_name AS name, brand_logo AS logo, initial FROM vehicle_brand WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no, id
SELECT id, store_name AS name, address FROM store WHERE status = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT MIN(ROUND(daily_price * discount_rate, 2)) AS min_price, MAX(ROUND(daily_price * discount_rate, 2)) AS max_price FROM vehicle WHERE deleted = 0 AND status != 0

SELECT v.id, CONCAT(b.brand_name, ' ', m.model_name) AS vehicle_name, b.brand_name, m.model_name, v.license_plate, v.daily_price, v.deposit, v.discount_rate, v.status, v.store_id, s.store_name, COALESCE( (SELECT vi.image_url FROM vehicle_image vi WHERE vi.vehicle_id = v.id ORDER BY vi.sort_no, vi.id LIMIT 1), m.cover_image ) AS cover_image FROM vehicle v JOIN vehicle_model m ON m.id = v.model_id AND m.deleted = 0 JOIN vehicle_brand b ON b.id = v.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 JOIN store s ON s.id = v.store_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.deleted = 0
